title: first coffee, 6:40am, house asleep
moment: It's Christmas morning, 6:40am, and the house is still asleep. One lamp is on in the corner, the only light besides the tree bulbs strung low across the mantel. This is the first coffee, held in both hands, white ceramic warm against my palms. Wool socks on the cold wood floor, steam curling up into the lamp's glow. Nobody else is up yet, and the quiet has a weight to it, the kind that only happens once a year.

light.source: one tungsten table lamp, shade on, in the corner
fill: a line of very small warm bulbs low on a shelf far behind the camera, 2200K, faint

inventory.text: two lines in ballpoint on a small card
inventory.gesture: both hands wrapped around the cup

never: any tree, star, gift or snowflake

fold.idea: The page keeps an account. Every section is an entry on one pitch, and one column accumulates.
fold.signature: the ruling is light: every rule is a gradient set by its distance from the lamp, so a page of empty ruled lines reads as a lit object

states.empty: Nothing has asked for you yet.
states.error: The count stopped at 5:02. Open the ledger and it starts again.
states.offline: Nothing since 4:12. Whatever arrives will wait.
states.first-run: This page is empty until tomorrow morning.

transient.name: the glazed base set down on the wood floor

transport.feel: one slow breath, in and out, the room's tone

motion.twin: the lamp is already at full, the beam is held, every ruling is lit one step brighter and nothing is waiting to arrive
